Summary: The HotpotQA paper reports the following joint F1 scores in Table 4: for the distractor setting, the baseline achieves 40.86 EM F1 on the dev set and 41.37 EM F1 on the test set; for the full wiki setting, the baseline scores 17.73 EM F1 on the dev set and 17.85 EM F1 on the test set. The performance in the full wiki setting is significantly lower due to the increased difficulty of retrieving relevant information from the entire Wikipedia compared to the distractor setting.
